about.text: The BCF that comes back from the architect: the reviewer's issue from nb-s14-door-bcf-review and a reply on the same topic, as two bcf.issue nodes with the same title, doors and camera. thread joins their rows by column name; because the title, doors and camera agree, bcf.write makes one topic holding both comments, under the same guidSeed as the reviewer's file so a viewer treats it as the same topic. The architect's text is written for this walk-through; it is not a real colleague's reply. bcf writes artifacts/checking/s14-door-bcf-reply.bcf only when you press Run.

review.title: 813 mm doors: 37 mm under the 850 mm rule
review.description: The two glazed exterior doors (M_Single-Glass 1, type 0813 x 2420mm) have an OverallWidth of 813 mm; rule DC-W1 asks for at least 850 mm.
review.comment: Both doors miss the 850 mm minimum by 37 mm, the smallest shortfall on the project. Please widen the leaf or confirm an exemption.
review.author: Reviewer

reply.title: 813 mm doors: 37 mm under the 850 mm rule
reply.description: The two glazed exterior doors (M_Single-Glass 1, type 0813 x 2420mm) have an OverallWidth of 813 mm; rule DC-W1 asks for at least 850 mm.
reply.comment: Agreed. I will check both openings and issue a wider leaf type in the next revision of the model; please rerun DC-W1 on it.
reply.author: Architect

answer.title: Both comments, one row per door and comment
